Application
Impact Tester - Impact Testing Machine
View PDF
Qualitest provides a complete selection of Pendulum Impact Testers designed to verify material toughness against strict international rules, including ASTM D256, ASTM D6110, ISO 179, and ISO 180. Our solutions are built to scale with your testing needs:
Wide Energy Range: We cover everything from delicate plastic components requiring as little as 0.5 Joules up to heavy-duty metal applications demanding 750 Joules.
The Q-Impact Series: Our best-selling line combines advanced performance with an economical price point, ensuring you get a reliable machine that fits your budget.
Flexible Configurations: Choose the setup that matches your workflow, with options for analog or digital displays as well as instrumented models for detailed data analysis.
Complete Sample Prep: To ensure valid results, we supply essential Specimen Notchers in both basic and automatic configurations.
Extended Impact Solutions: Beyond pendulum testing, our catalog acts as a single source for Drop Weight, Falling Dart, and Gardner testers, covering every aspect of impact analysis.
